_comment: The $RCLAW token that exists on Solana mainnet. ONE record: the website
(bot/token/record.py -> /rclaw) both read this file, so no surface can
name a second mint. Every value was read back from the chain and the
Jupiter token index on verified_at (see basis). Re-read before editing.

token/ runs against; it is not this token.

presale._comment: ANNOUNCED: the terms of the Smithii sale, written the way the website and the bot print them. Each is derived from token/presale/smithii.config.json (smithii_lib.mjs, recordTerms) and token/presale/the_record_states_the_sale.test.mjs fails when they differ, so change the config first and copy what the test prints. null is NOT ANNOUNCED (for sale_url: the sale is not created yet), and every reader says so in words; never fill a field with a placeholder. sale_url is set after Create: an https link on smithii.io, the only kind the website and the bot will show (tests/fixtures/sale_url_cases.json). After editing, run node app/scripts/sync_content.js.
presale.date: 15 Oct → 29 Oct 2026, or until the hard cap
presale.hard_cap: 5,000 SOL (soft cap 1,000 SOL: a target, not enforced)
presale.claim: 100% when the sale ends. No vesting for buyers
presale.after_sale: The team creates the pool at the sale price with 80% of the SOL raised and burns the LP. The sale contract does not do this.
